title: European Commission and Ukraine agree on 2027 support loan
excerpt: The European Commission and Ukraine have confirmed plans for a €45 billion loan allocation for 2027.
bodyHtml:
The European Commission and Ukraine announced on October 1, 2026, that they have identified the means to cover Ukraine's budget and defence needs for 2026. The two parties have reconfirmed the steps required to ensure the timely release of these funds.

For 2027, the parties agreed to move forward with the allocation of €45 billion under the Ukraine Support Loan, provided that established conditions are met. The European Commission and Ukraine also agreed to begin work on identifying additional budgetary and defence needs for the country.

All sides involved in the agreement stated that other partners should also fulfil their financial commitments and step up their efforts in light of the significant challenges Ukraine is facing.

The European Commission and Ukraine also agreed to hold monthly meetings to coordinate their joint efforts.
topic: Joint statement by the European Commission and Ukraine
